Adding technical clarifications from runtime side:

1) Tokenization and PII: We recommend redaction or client-side pseudonymization for explicit identifiers (SSNs, full names if not required). For staged testing, we can enable a pseudonymization filter at the proxy so downstream workers only see tokens.

2) KV cache: Our serving runtime stores KV caches on GPUs for latency. No PII is written to filesystem in plaintext; caches are memory-only and rotated on node restart.

3) KMS & export: Customer-managed KMS is supported on Redwood Private/Dedicated. For hosted integrations, keys are in our KMS (AES-256) with HSM-backed access for production. For staging, we can offer on-shore egress routing to keep egress nodes in US only.

I attached a short note (part of the ZIP) describing these options and recommended toggles for MedaLabs' staging environment.

- Priyom

Tom/Julie — short answers inline and attached small retention exhibit (medalabs-ssq-complete.xlsx):

- Raw ingest storage: for hosted staging we buffer payloads in memory on the proxy for up to 30 seconds for batching; we do not persist raw requests in object storage. Application-level logs are pseudonymized by default.

- Retention exhibit: staging logs (request metadata + pseudonymized token IDs) retained 7 days; full debug traces (accessed only via escalated ticket) retained 30 days and then purged. Deletion is automated; we provide a purge audit log (timestamp + job id). Evidence samples can be produced under NDA.

- Cross-border fallback: when on-shore nodes are saturated we will queue short-lived requests and attempt on-shore burst capacity (if reserved). If burst capacity exhausted and client allows, traffic will fail-open to multi-region hosted nodes (details and opt-out in playbook). We recommend MedaLabs select the strict on-shore-only option for regulated testing; we can add a playbook step that enforces rejection rather than fail-open.

Next steps: Connor will produce the final ZIP containing the PII mapping, annotated diagram PNG, Priyom's technical addendum, and the retention exhibit. Expect delivery by EOD Pacific.

Thanks,
Hannah
